stitch_project.title: O-TRAVELZ Mobile V4 — M2 Visual Exploration
stitch_project.description: Dedicated Stitch project for parallel exploration of Android Material 3 and iOS HIG visual directions across 8 core surfaces.
stitch_project.isolation_guarantee: Completely isolated from Web V4 concepts and production mobile codebases.

governance_rules.zero_production_code: Stitch HTML/React output is strictly an interim conceptual design artifact. Zero Stitch code is committed to mobile/android, mobile/ios, or mobile/shared.
governance_rules.figma_boundary: Approved concepts will be reconstructed canonically in Figma once authenticated read/write access is verified.
